training_sample_match: Same 1600 unique samples as R16G I2V; T2V loader uses the R18E/G filtered 1600-row set and SampleOrder(seed42) order
architecture: R16G design unchanged except task entry: R15C local 5x3x3 video-state operator (video V, direct zero-init full-width local Q condition) plus three independent state-gated global execution writes from direct C, request-bound C, and joint direct+request C. Each read has its own zero-init full-width 3072->3072 output and zero-init full-width 3072->3072 multiplicative state gate. No raw Qwen request word is written globally and there is no low-dimensional bottleneck. T2V has no first latent frame: all 21 frames are noisy, every token receives a native time position, the physical write covers every token, and the generation loss covers every frame. Native text Q/K/V/O stay frozen; training and normal inference use the same forward.
